prompts.title: Session guide
prompts.summary: A guide clients read before the shoot: what to wear, where, when and what to expect.
prompts.prompt: Write a session guide for a [session type] with [my business] at [location] around [time]. Cover: what to wear (colors, textures, what to skip), what to bring, how kids or pets usually go, the weather plan, how long it takes, and when photos arrive. Warm and short.
prompts.use: Send it when they book and again two days before.

prompts.title: Session pricing
prompts.summary: Prices a session from shoot, travel, culling and editing hours.
prompts.prompt: Price a [session type]. Shoot [hours], travel [hours], culling [hours], editing [hours], gallery and delivery [hours]. Costs per session: [ ]. Target per hour: [$]. Show the price, then three packages, and the line I use when someone asks why.
prompts.use: Re-run when your editing time changes.

prompts.title: Gallery delivery email
prompts.summary: Delivers the gallery with how to download, print and share, and asks for a review.
prompts.prompt: Write the gallery delivery email for [client] from [my business]. Gallery link [ ], available until [date], how to download, where I recommend printing, how to credit me if they post, and one line asking for a Google review [link], no reward offered.
prompts.use: Send within your promised delivery time.

hooks: Your site needs twelve photos, not two hundred.
